summary: RegexBuilder is a Swift result-builder DSL that compiles to Swift regex values. It is a Swift language library, and BifrOSt apps are Rust; no regex DSL exists in springboard/sdk or springboard/ui.

features.note: Swift-only DSL; Rust apps write patterns as strings

features.apple: One, Optionally, ZeroOrMore, OneOrMore, Repeat, Local

gaps: Not applicable as a framework: the DSL is Swift-only. The Rust equivalent would be a crate choice, not a BifrOSt API.
